scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/aemcloudproject/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/aemcloudproject
  set jcr:title{String} to "Aem Cloud Project"
end
create service user myaemproject-serviceuser with path /home/users/system

set ACL for myaemproject-serviceuser 
allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:lockManagement on /content/aemcloudproject 
allow jcr:read on /conf/aemcloudproject 
allow jcr:read,rep:write,jcr:versionManagement,jcr:lockManagement,crx:replicate on /content/dam/aemcloudproject 
end
